item.content:encoded:
Isaac Paredes hits a solo home run to left field in the 1st inning and gives the Astros a 1-0 lead against the Braves
Video Transcript
Paredes tries one to left, and that ball's gone.
Isiah Paredes, number 22 of the year, and the Astros take a one-nothing lead.
Well, I just love the fact that he swings and misses at a slider early in the count.
This kind of goes to what Bogey was talking about.
He gets a mistake fastball in the middle part of the plate at 96 and hits a rope into the Crawford Boxes
